doctrine: Catalogue versionne des evenements FREKCORE (Bloc 7). Chaque entree distingue le contrat specifie de son etat d'implementation reel — Evidence First (voir reports/02_GAP_ANALYSIS.md).

envelope_schema.title: FREK Event Envelope
envelope_schema.description: Enveloppe generique pour tout evenement FREKCORE v1. Implementee par backend/eventbus/envelope.py:EventEnvelope (Phase 2, Priorite 5) et emise par de vrais producteurs a partir de Phase 2 Priorite 6 (voir 'implemented' par entree du catalogue ci-dessous).

producer.description: Module qui a emis l'evenement, ex: 'identity_engine'.

subject.description: FREK-ID principal concerne par l'evenement, si applicable.

correlation_id.description: Identifiant reliant plusieurs evenements d'une meme requete/flux.

schema_version.description: Version du schema du payload (pas de l'enveloppe).

catalog.evidence: Phase 2 Priorite 6: backend/identity_engine/routes.py:126-130 (POST /identity/init) publishes a real EventEnvelope via backend/eventbus/bus.py:default_bus, built by backend/eventbus/producers.py:build_identity_created_event(). Publish is best-effort (wrapped in try/except, never blocks identity creation — see routes.py:39-43,124-130). Verified by backend/tests/test_eventbus.py::test_build_identity_created_event_matches_envelope_contract and test_identity_engine_wires_eventbus_without_raising_on_publish_failure (unit, no live server/Mongo needed). NOT yet verified end-to-end against a live server + MongoDB in this sandbox (see reports/10_TEST_INFRASTRUCTURE.md) — the wiring itself is real code, not aspirational, but full integration coverage remains a gap.

P1 backlog (2026-08-31): backend/identity_engine/routes.py's PATCH /{frek_id} (update_identity) publishes a real EventEnvelope via backend/eventbus/producers.py:build_identity_updated_event(), best-effort (try/except, never blocks the response). payload carries changed_fields (names only, never the new values, so this event can't leak PII by existing) — see docs/architecture/FREK_ID_RECONCILIATION.md's P1 implementation update. Verified by backend/tests/test_eventbus.py::test_build_identity_updated_event_never_carries_field_values (unit) and backend/tests/test_identity_lifecycle.py::TestUpdate (live, mongomock-backed server).

catalog.description: Un titulaire ayant perdu tous ses Passkeys a retrouve l'acces a son FREK-ID existant via la cle admin (RECOVERY, docs/decisions/0003-...md Section 3).
catalog.evidence: P2 backlog (2026-08-31): backend/identity_engine/routes.py's register_begin/register_complete publish a real EventEnvelope via backend/eventbus/producers.py:build_identity_recovered_event() specifically when an already-credentialed identity is recovered via the X-Admin-Key path (not ordinary holder-initiated credential rotation, which does not fire this event). frek_id is never regenerated; payload has no 'new_frek_id' field by design. Notarized (payload_type=identity_recovery). Verified by backend/tests/test_eventbus.py::test_build_identity_recovered_event_matches_envelope_contract (unit) and backend/tests/test_identity_recovery_unit.py (7 tests, isolated FastAPI app + mongomock_motor).

catalog.description: Fusion de deux identites (Bloc 2 — Identity Engine: Merge).
catalog.evidence: docs/decisions/0003-identity-lifecycle-founder-decisions-implemented.md Section 1 (founder-approved, 2026-08-31): true fusion/merge of two identities is explicitly rejected — 'never delete or overwrite a FREK-ID', 'existing references to reconciled IDs must remain resolvable'. This literal event_type (destructive merge) will never be implemented. See identity.reconciled below for the approved, non-destructive replacement concept.

catalog.description: Etablit une relation d'identite canonique non-destructive entre deux FREK-ID (MERGE, docs/decisions/0003-...md Section 1).
catalog.evidence: P2 backlog (2026-08-31): backend/identity_engine/routes.py's POST /{frek_id}/reconcile (reconcile_identity) appends one record to frek_reconciliations (never deletes, updates, or overwrites either identity) and publishes a real EventEnvelope via backend/eventbus/producers.py:build_identity_reconciled_event(), best-effort. Notarized (payload_type=identity_reconciliation). Authorization requires dual holder-session consent for same-system targets or the admin key (prevents cross-holder takeover); cross-system (frek_v1) targets are admin-only, since frek_v1 has no holder-session concept to verify consent against. Verified by backend/tests/test_eventbus.py::test_build_identity_reconciled_event_matches_envelope_contract (unit) and backend/tests/test_identity_reconcile_unit.py (9 tests, isolated FastAPI app + mongomock_motor — non-destructiveness, dual-consent, cross-system admin-only, idempotency, bidirectional visibility).

P1 backlog (2026-08-31): backend/identity_engine/routes.py's POST /{frek_id}/revocation (revoke_identity — see docs/architecture/FREK_ID_RECONCILIATION.md for why the path is /revocation, not /revoke: frek_v1 already owns POST /{frek_id}/revoke at the identical mounted path) publishes a real EventEnvelope via backend/eventbus/producers.py:build_identity_revoked_event(), best-effort. Also notarized (payload_type=identity_revocation, backend/notary/service.py:notarize_event()). Distinct from frek_identities.revoked (frek_v1's own, separate field/system — see reports/FREKCORE_CONTRADICTIONS.md C1) — this entry now covers identity_engine's revoke. Verified by backend/tests/test_eventbus.py::test_build_identity_revoked_event_matches_envelope_contract and backend/tests/test_identity_lifecycle.py::TestRevoke (live, mongomock-backed server).

catalog.description: Creation d'un objet culturel (FK Cultural Object Container).
catalog.evidence: P1 backlog (2026-08-31): backend/fk/routes.py POST /fk/create publishes a real EventEnvelope via backend/eventbus/producers.py:build_object_created_event(), right after db.fk_objects.insert_one(doc), best-effort (try/except, never blocks FK creation — same pattern as identity_engine/routes.py:126-130). Payload echoes only fields GET /api/v1/fk/detail/{frek_id} already returns publicly (storage_path excluded, verified by backend/tests/test_eventbus.py::test_build_object_created_event_never_carries_storage_path). Verified by backend/tests/test_eventbus.py::test_build_object_created_event_matches_envelope_contract (unit, producer output only) and backend/tests/test_fk_object_created_event.py (isolated FastAPI app + TestClient, mongomock_motor-backed, no external server process — monkeypatches fk.routes's own bus reference to a test-local InProcessEventBus, subscribes to object.created, and asserts the real envelope arrives on a real POST /fk/create call, proving the wiring itself, not just the producer function).
backend/fk/routes.py POST /fk/verify retourne un resultat synchrone au caller mais n'emet pas d'evenement persistant/diffuse.
